ambiguous.completion_condition: The minimal graph diff is explained and immutable resolution, build/tests, and post-update scans satisfy policy. Structural validation, extracted WIT, compatibility, composition, minimum capabilities, and denied-capability tests pass.
ambiguous.stop_condition: Stop on stale or uncertain advisory data, unexplained graph churn, integrity/source changes, incompatible licenses, or unavailable required resolution evidence. Stop on ambiguous model/WASI generation, stale bindings, incompatible WIT, unexpected imports, ambient authority, or missing component evidence.

ambiguous.request: Validate a component's WIT and capability policy, then stage its SBOM, provenance, signature, and publication bundle.

extracted WIT, import/export, and capability evidence
version files, tags, and release configuration

unnecessary_or_forbidden_tools: publishing, signing, or remote mutation without exact authority
CI runner redesign unrelated to release evidence
ambiguous.completion_condition: Structural validation, extracted WIT, compatibility, composition, minimum capabilities, and denied-capability tests pass. The staged or published subjects, digests, SBOM, provenance, signatures, and independent verification all satisfy the declared release contract.
ambiguous.stop_condition: Stop on ambiguous model/WASI generation, stale bindings, incompatible WIT, unexpected imports, ambient authority, or missing component evidence. Stop on ambiguous source state, missing required evidence, mismatched subjects or identities, or absent publication authority.

execution.method: Run all prompts through skills.search_many with eight candidates, then apply the final SKILL.md trigger and boundary text to select or reject candidates.
notes: Candidate retrieval surfaced every expected public specialized skill after two ambiguous prompts were made more explicit about both requested responsibilities.

The two routine-verification negatives intentionally select no specialized public skill; test-and-regression may be retrieved by its name, but its final description explicitly rejects routine test execution after ordinary changes.
Ambiguous cases select both skills only when the request contains substantive work owned by both; otherwise the neighboring skill is explicitly non-selected.
